name: Shopaccino
description_en:
Shopaccino is a managed cloud commerce platform for retail, wholesale and multi-warehouse operations. It combines storefront, catalogue, orders, inventory and marketing, while mobile apps, Web POS and some third-party messaging require separate subscriptions.

Current plans distinguish basic launch, automation/international selling, B2B/multi-warehouse and custom marketplace needs. A zero platform transaction fee does not make payment processing or external services free.
description_zh:
Shopaccino 是面向零售、批发及多仓运营的托管云电商平台，结合店面、目录、订单、库存和营销，移动应用、Web POS 及部分第三方消息需另订阅。

当前套餐区分基础开店、自动化国际销售、B2B 多仓及定制市场需求。平台交易费为零，不表示支付处理或外部服务免费。

core_features.explanation_en: ProCommerce lists wholesale controls and up to five warehouses; custom scope extends further.
core_features.explanation_zh: ProCommerce 列有批发控制及最多 5 仓，更多范围需定制。

core_features.explanation_en: Use merchant gateway accounts; app/POS and messaging providers have separate conditions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用商家网关账户，应用 POS 及消息服务另有条件。

sections.title_en: Approve a business buyer before showing wholesale terms
sections.title_zh: 展示批发条件前先批准企业买方
sections.en: The pricing detail describes B2B registration approval, minimum order quantities, case-pack increments and credit sales. A wholesaler could test an unapproved buyer, an approved group and an invalid pack quantity. Do not infer credit approval or debt collection from the ability to place an account order. Configure price policy and warehouse assignment before importing live buyers.
sections.zh: 定价细表介绍 B2B 注册审批、最小订量、整箱倍数及赊销。批发商可测试未批准买方、已批准组及无效整箱数量。能赊账下单，不等于已经完成信用审批或追款。导入正式买方前应配置价格政策及仓库分配。

sections.title_en: Budget by annual plan and operating limits
sections.title_zh: 按年度套餐及运营额度预算
sections.en: The retrieved USD annual view lists StartUp at US$290/year with 1,000 products/two staff, Scale at US$690 with 5,000/five, and ProCommerce at US$1,300 with 20,000/ten and up to five warehouses. TailorMade is custom. These are annual prices, not monthly amounts, and taxes are excluded. App, POS, SMS/WhatsApp, gateway and optional paid setup costs need separate checks.
sections.zh: 读取的美元年付视图列出 StartUp 每年 290 美元，1,000 商品／2 员工；Scale 690 美元，5,000／5；ProCommerce 1,300 美元，20,000／10，最多 5 仓；TailorMade 定制。这些是年价、非月价，且不含税。应用、POS、短信 WhatsApp、支付和可选付费配置需分别核对。

sections.title_en: Managed hosting and data export are different rights
sections.title_zh: 托管环境与数据导出是不同权利
sections.en: The pricing FAQ says hosting/source-code access is not supplied, while products, customers and orders can be downloaded as Excel/CSV. A move to another platform requires rebuilding the website. It describes cancellation without refund and service through the paid period. Check whether your required fields, images and historical relationships survive export; no migration was executed.
sections.zh: 定价 FAQ 说明不提供托管及源码访问，但可将商品、客户、订单下载为 Excel／CSV，迁移后需重建网站；取消不退款，服务持续至已付周期结束。应检查所需字段、图片及历史关系能否完整导出，本文未执行迁移。

sections.title_en: Test a warehouse and return exception before rollout
sections.title_zh: 推广前测试仓库及退货例外
sections.en: Merchants combining retail and wholesale have a relevant case; a team seeking a self-hosted codebase does not obtain that from this SaaS offer. Prepare product IDs, stock per location, approved customer groups and shipping/payment accounts. The 14-day trial is for evaluation. No order routing, tax correctness, recovery or search/AI-discovery outcome was independently verified.
sections.zh: 结合零售批发的商家有相关场景；需要自托管源码的团队，不能从此 SaaS 方案获得该权利。应准备商品标识、分地点库存、批准客户组及配送支付账户。14 天试用用于评估；本文未独立核实订单路由、税额正确性、恢复或搜索 AI 曝光效果。
